issues.failure_explanation: With the fluctuations of eq:fluctuation_definition one computes w^{-T}D^- + w^{+T}D^+ = {{w^T B}}[[u]] + [[w^T f]] - [[w]]^T f^*. Hence the right-hand identity of the display is equivalent to the SUM w^{-T}D^- + w^{+T}D^+ = [[F]], i.e. 2{{w^T D}} = [[F]], not to {{w^T D}} = [[F]]. As written the two sides of the displayed equivalence are not equivalent.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace {{w^T D}} by w^{-T}D^- + w^{+T}D^+ (or 2{{w^T D}}) on the left of the equivalence.
issues.overall_effect: Only the left-hand form of the condition is misstated; the right-hand form, which is what Theorem thm:ec_flux verifies and what the scheme requires, is the correct one, so the EC/ES guarantees are unaffected.
issues.title: Stated equivalence in the entropy conservation condition is off by a factor 2
issues.why_classification: Local restatement of a displayed condition; no argument or guarantee depends on the erroneous factor.

issues.failure_explanation: The display assigns the same expression to D^+_EC and D^-_EC (it only involves u^- and a fixed sign). Then D^-_EC + D^+_EC = 2 f^EC - 2 f(u^-) + B(u^-)[[u]], which is not [[f]] + trapezoidal path integral, so the path-conservation condition eq:path_conservation_cond and the EC condition fail for the pair. Substituting f^*=f^EC in eq:fluctuation_definition gives the intended D^+_EC = f(u^+) - f^EC + (1/2)B(u^+)[[u]], which the well-balanced proof (with h^{\pm}) implicitly uses.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Write D^+_EC(u^-,u^+) = f(u^+) - f^EC(u^-,u^+) + (1/2)B(u^+)[[u]] separately from D^-_EC.
issues.overall_effect: As literally written the scheme eq:es_dgsem (which uses D^+ at left interfaces) would be inconsistent and not entropy conservative; the intended definition from eq:fluctuation_definition restores all claims.
issues.title: EC fluctuations defined with D^+ identical to D^-, violating path conservation
issues.why_classification: The correct form is determined by the general definition eq:fluctuation_definition with f^*=f^EC; no result changes.

issues.failure_explanation: With w the SWME entropy variables of Corollary cor:entropy:variables, [[w_1]]{{hu_m}} contains -(1/2)Σ[[α_j^2]]{{hu_m}}/(2j+1), so the left side of eq:entropy_conservation_condition_swe equals -(1/2)Σ_j[[α_j^2]]{{hu_m}}/(2j+1) ≠ 0; the display holds only for the SWE entropy variables. Correspondingly, the expansion in eq:leftside:EC:P omits the term Σ_j [[α_j]]{{hu_m}}{{α_j}}/(2j+1) coming from [[w]]^T f̄^{EC,SWE}. The two omissions cancel exactly (this is the quoted identity), so the final conclusion of the theorem is correct, but the two intermediate equalities as written are false.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: State eq:entropy_conservation_condition_swe for the SWE entropy variables (or with the extra Ψ-term explicit) and include the omitted term in eq:leftside:EC:P, showing the cancellation via the stated identity.
issues.overall_effect: The theorem's conclusion and all EC/ES guarantees remain valid; only the bookkeeping of the proof is incorrect as stated.
issues.title: Intermediate step in the EC flux proof is false with the SWME entropy variables (errors cancel)
issues.why_classification: Routine rewrite of two proof lines; the theorem and its uses survive unchanged.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: that for  constant bottom topography satisfies the relation $\text{diag}(\bar{\mbf{H}}, 1) \jump{\bB{w}} = \jump{\bB{u}}$

issues.failure_explanation: From the entropy variables, dh = (dw_1 + u_m dw_2 + Σα_i dw_{i+2})/g, dm = u_m dh + h dw_2, dq_i = α_i dh + (2i+1)h dw_{i+2}, so the inverse Hessian is (1/g)(y y^T + diag(0, gh, 3gh, …, (2N+1)gh)). With z_1 = 1 the (1,1) entry becomes 2/g instead of 1/g, so H̄ is not the inverse Hessian and diag(H̄,1)[[w]] = [[u]] fails (first component picks up an extra [[w_1]]/g). Also (2n+1) uses the Manning coefficient symbol n for N.

failure_location.quote: \mbf{z} = (1, gh, 3gh, \dots, (2n+1)gh)^{\rm T}$ is the positive definite inverse of the Hessian of the entropy function

issues.overall_effect: The interpretation of the interface dissipation as an entropy-variable Rusanov term and the stated relation to [[u]] are wrong as written; entropy stability (needing only positive definiteness, which still holds) and well-balancedness ([[w]]=0 at lake-at-rest) are unaffected.
issues.title: Dissipation matrix is not the inverse entropy Hessian: first entry of z should be 0, not 1
issues.why_classification: One entry correction restores the claimed property; ES and WB proofs do not depend on the erroneous entry.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: the unscaled coefficients are $\widetilde{A}_{ijk}\coloneqq A_{ijk}/(2i+1)$ and $\widetilde{B}_{ijk} \coloneqq B_{ijk}/(2i+1)$

issues.failure_explanation: eq:condition is an identity for the unscaled tensors. Multiplying by (2k+1) gives A_{kji} = -B_{kji} - ((2k+1)/(2i+1)) B_{ijk}, which differs from the appendix formula whenever i≠k and B̃_{ijk}≠0 (e.g. N=2: B̃_{112} = -2∫_0^1(ζ-ζ^2)φ_2 dζ = 1/15 ≠ 0). The appendix also inverts the scaling ('A_{ijk} = Ã_{ijk}/(2i+1)'). Tensors computed with the stated formula are not the A_{ijk} of eq:Aijk_Bijk and do not satisfy eq:condition, which the discrete EC proof relies on.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use A_{kji} = -(B_{kji} + (2k+1)B_{ijk}/(2i+1)), or compute A_{ijk} directly by quadrature.
issues.overall_effect: The described computational procedure yields incorrect A_{ijk} for i≠k, so an implementation following it would not solve the intended SWME nor satisfy the discrete EC identity; the analytical results are unaffected.
issues.title: Appendix recipe for A_{ijk} from B_{ijk} uses wrong normalization
issues.why_classification: Trivial scaling correction in an auxiliary computational recipe; no theorem depends on it.
